meta.syncMode: Manual sync by ChatGPT until direct API integration

operatingThresholds.note: Internal decision thresholds for this account — not universal ecommerce benchmarks. They are calibrated from recent TigerBrands data and should be replaced by margin-based targets once break-even CPA/ROAS are locked.

financialTargets.note: Profitability verdict stays provisional until contribution margin gives us a hard target CPA and break-even ROAS.

roas.label: ROAS
roas.basis: יעד תפעולי שכבר שימש אותנו: 3+ נחשב סיגנל חזק. זה עדיין לא break-even ROAS עד שנכניס מרווח תרומה אמיתי.

shopifyCvr.label: Shopify CVR
shopifyCvr.basis: 3% הוא יעד עבודה כי יום הייחוס החזק האחרון היה 3.26%. מתחת ל-1.5% דורש בדיקה לפני שמאשימים את המדיה.

ctr.label: CTR
ctr.basis: היעד יושב סביב רמת הימים הטובים האחרונים בחשבון, שבהם CTR היה בערך 4.3%–4.5%.

cpc.label: CPC
cpc.basis: בימים הטובים האחרונים ה-CPC היה סביב $0.47–$0.55. לכן ≤$0.55 הוא יעד, ועד $0.75 עדיין טווח מעקב.

costPerLpv.label: Cost / LPV
costPerLpv.basis: יום הייחוס החזק היה סביב $0.99 ל-LPV. היעד $1.05 שומר אותנו קרוב לרמה שכבר הוכחנו שאפשר להשיג.

lpvToAtc.label: LPV → ATC
lpvToAtc.basis: 20% הוא סף כוונת קנייה בריא לחשבון הזה. הוא שמרני ביחס ליום הייחוס החזק, שבו היחס היה גבוה משמעותית.

costPerAtc.label: Cost / ATC
costPerAtc.basis: יום הייחוס החזק היה $2.77 ל-ATC, וה-Winner CBO הנוכחי סביב $4.51. לכן $4.50 הוא יעד תפעולי סביר ולא תיאורטי.

atcToCheckout.label: ATC → Checkout
atcToCheckout.basis: 40% הוא יעד מעבר מסל ל-checkout: יום הייחוס החזק היה בדיוק סביב הרמה הזו. מתחת ל-25% כבר מצביע על חיכוך משמעותי.

costPerCheckout.label: Cost / Checkout
costPerCheckout.basis: יום הייחוס החזק היה בערך $6.93 ל-checkout והיום החלש הבא היה סביב $8.94. לכן $8 הוא יעד עבודה ברור.

checkoutToPurchase.label: Checkout → Purchase
checkoutToPurchase.basis: 30% הוא יעד סגירת checkout. ביום הייחוס החזק היינו 37.5%, ולכן זה יעד שכבר הוכחנו שאפשר לעבור.

lpvToPurchase.label: LPV → Purchase
lpvToPurchase.basis: 4% מ-paid LPV לרכישה הוא יעד הסיגנל שלנו. 2%–4% הוא ביניים; מתחת ל-2% חלש עד שיוכח אחרת במדגם גדול יותר.

cpa.label: CPA
cpa.basis: זה יעד ביצועים זמני, לא יעד רווחיות. יום הייחוס החזק היה $18.47 CPA וה-Winner CBO הגיע בערך ל-$22.56. נחליף אותו ברגע שנחשב break-even CPA אמיתי.

cpm.label: CPM
cpm.basis: הימים הטובים האחרונים היו באזור $22.6–$23.7 CPM. לכן ≤$24 הוא יעד; $24–$28 הוא טווח מעקב, לא סיבה לכבות קמפיין לבד.

advisor.headline: Historical reference: efficient acquisition day
advisor.body: Strong paid efficiency and healthy funnel progression. Use this as a historical comparison point, not as a reason to force today to look identical.

advisor.headline: Historical reference: low-spend high-efficiency day
advisor.body: Very efficient purchase day on limited spend. Treat the result as a useful reference, while remembering the sample was small.

advisor.headline: Historical weak purchase day
advisor.body: Traffic costs were acceptable but paid purchase conversion disappeared. This is the kind of day where the funnel should be inspected before restructuring the account.

advisor.headline: Historical strong scaling reference
advisor.body: High volume with strong CTR, healthy LPV-to-cart progression and profitable-looking paid efficiency. Useful benchmark for a day where more spend still produced downstream results.

campaigns.name: NOVA | ABO | CREATIVE TESTING | NEW CUSTOMERS | IL
campaigns.advisor: KEEP — this was a strong reference day. No structural intervention justified.

campaigns.name: TEST | NovaHair | New Creative Concepts | IL | $7
campaigns.advisor: WATCH/STOP TEST — weak early signal, but this is a test unit, not a reason to restructure winners.

advisor.headline: Reference day: leave the winning system alone
advisor.body: This day establishes why the next weak day should have been treated as variance first, not as proof the delivery structure stopped working.

campaigns.name: NOVA | ABO | CREATIVE TESTING | NEW CUSTOMERS | IL
campaigns.advisor: HOLD — weak purchase result, but one day after a very strong day and with downstream checkout intent. Do not rebuild the account from this alone.

campaigns.name: TEST | NovaHair | New Creative Concepts | IL | $7
campaigns.advisor: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE — no decision from a one-dollar slice.

campaigns.name: NOVA | CBO | WINNERS | NEW CUSTOMERS | IL
campaigns.advisor: THIS WAS THE STRUCTURAL EXPERIMENT. If you choose it, it should be the only structural change for the day — no old CBO activation on top.

advisor.headline: Hindsight: I would have made zero structural changes
advisor.body: The prior day was strong. The main delivery campaign had a bad purchase day, but the funnel still produced meaningful checkout intent. My preferred action would have been: keep the existing winner delivery unchanged, keep the small test budget separate, and review again on a rolling 3-day view. If cash protection was essential, make one budget reduction only — not a migration to a new CBO plus an old-CBO reactivation.

campaigns.name: NOVA | CBO | WINNERS | NEW CUSTOMERS | IL
campaigns.advisor: FUNNEL HEALTHY ENOUGH TO KEEP. The campaign was the strongest paid unit today. Its pause is a cash-protection decision, not evidence that the CBO failed.

campaigns.name: NOVA | ABO | CREATIVE TESTING | NEW CUSTOMERS | IL
campaigns.advisor: TOO SMALL TO JUDGE. Keep only as a controlled test; do not use it to infer account-wide health.

campaigns.name: CBO - Nova
campaigns.advisor: PAUSE WAS REASONABLE FOR CASH CONTROL, but four LPVs are not enough to statistically prove the old CBO is bad.

advisor.headline: Today: stop changing variables
advisor.body: The Winner CBO itself has an acceptable-to-strong funnel signal. The bigger problem is change density. Preserve the current state until the next planned review instead of trying another structure today.

decisionPolicy.headline: Decision Guard v2 — advisor has veto, not validation
rules: Default change budget: maximum 2 meaningful account-level interventions per day, and maximum 1 budget/status/structure change per campaign in any 24-hour period.
Normal budget adjustment: 20–30% at most, once per 24 hours. Do not staircase $30 → $25 → $15 in the same day unless the goal is simply emergency cash protection.
If you need spend to stop now, PAUSE. A lower daily budget is not a hard stop and Meta can continue spending after the edit.
Never launch a new winner structure and reactivate an old structure on the same day. Pick one experiment so the result is interpretable.
Use a rolling 3-day view for winner decisions. One weak day after a strong day is a warning, not a verdict.
For low-budget campaigns, avoid judging before roughly 15–25 LPVs or the financial stop-loss is reached, unless there is a confirmed technical failure.
Review windows: 12:00 and 18:00 Israel time. Outside them, no discretionary account changes.
When you propose a change, ChatGPT must first classify it KEEP / CHANGE / STOP and give the strongest argument against your proposal. Agreement is not the default.
If a requested action breaks these guardrails, ChatGPT should say so and require an explicit OVERRIDE before executing the write action.
stopLossLogic: Hard financial stop-loss should be based on target CPA / break-even ROAS once contribution margin is entered.
If 0 purchases AND mid-funnel is weak, stop earlier when spend reaches the financial threshold.
If 0 purchases BUT LPV→ATC and ATC→Checkout are healthy, allow more time / the next review window because purchase conversion can lag.
If there is already a purchase and the funnel is healthy, do not kill solely because same-day ROAS is below target; check rolling 3-day performance first.

decisionLog.action: Winner CBO built/started late in the day
decisionLog.assessment: Understandable experiment, but should have been the only structural experiment if kept.
Defensive pause was reasonable; activation added an unnecessary second structural variable.
Too many same-day budget edits. In future choose one cut, or pause if a hard stop is needed.
Do not toggle it again without a scheduled review and written reason.
